'''2007 Australian Championship Paul Sutcliffe DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Sutcliffe]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' YGBS (You're gonna be sorry - Team Alights?)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
